reading.body:
Bennie Thompson's AI record is mostly legislation and mostly money, with five committee contributions from Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Amazon totaling $16,500 across 2025 and 2026.

The legislative side is consistent: five cosponsorships and one sponsorship of AI-related bills, covering workforce readiness, HBCU research, algorithmic bias, biometric privacy, and civil rights. The votes recorded are all yes or absent, never no. That pattern is what a member's AI record looks like when the member is not a swing vote on the issue.

The contributions are the part that connects to compute. Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Amazon are the companies building and buying the data centers whose power demand is now the constraint on AI scaling. Money from those committees to a member who also legislates on AI is a fact the data records without asserting causation, and the page says so directly.

What the data does not cover: the content of any bill, what any vote would have done, whether any contribution influenced any decision, or any AI activity outside Congress. It is 17 dated events, nothing more.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for Bennie Thompson: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 17 events.
